integrity: All rational coefficient data are derived by exhaustive exact polygon clipping and Green-integral identities in the standalone checker. No independent mathematical audit has been performed; publication priority remains subject to discovery of unindexed equivalents.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the stationary Haar horizontal displacement through three steps of the exact symmetric orthogonal tents map; it makes no claim for other parameters, arbitrary initial states or later displacement times.
title: Exact three-step displacement law and a sixty-fold uniformization in the orthogonal tents map
